study type: Mixed-method rapid assessment (cross-sectional survey, in-depth interviews, key informant interviews)
outcome: Percentage of people suffering from general illness
Percentage of people suffering from chronic illness
Percentage of people seeking maternal care
Health system challenges (financing, information sharing, human resources, testing, leadership)
cohort: The study included a cross-sectional survey of 476 households, in-depth interviews with 22 slum dwellers, and key informant interviews with 16 local healthcare providers and 4 policymakers/technical experts from urban slums in Dhaka North, Dhaka South, and Gazipur City Corporation, Bangladesh.
finding: The COVID-19 pandemic significantly impacted the health system in urban slums of Bangladesh, leading to reduced healthcare use, mismanagement of resources, inadequate information sharing, human resource shortages, insufficient testing, and barriers to effective pandemic management.
